ns2:course.label: Social Perspectives on the Family
ns2:course.description: Examines the societal forces shaping aspects of stable and changing family relations in the U. S. and other countries; focuses on social-structural factors affecting marriage, divorce, co-habitation, child-bearing, the division of work and authority, and other features of life. Prerequisite: One of the following: SOC 100, SOC 101, or SOC 163.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: One of the following: SOC 100, SOC 101, or SOC 163.
